label: Diagram 2.35
caption:
Diagram 2.35 Wall types 3.1 and 3.2 – | Diagram 2.36 External cavity wall at
ceiling and roof junction | eaves level Junctions with ceiling and roof space
description: A section headed "Diagram 2.35 Wall types 3.1 and 3.2 – ceiling and roof junction", marked "SECTION" at the lower right. The wall is a cross-hatched masonry core with an independent panel on each side, drawn as vertical strips; zigzag break lines show that its height is shortened. At the top a horizontal line is labelled "Roof", and a cross-hatched block filling the gap between the top of the core and the roof is labelled "Flexible closer". Lower down a horizontal line labelled "Ceiling" meets the wall on each side; the panels stop at the ceiling and the core carries on up into the roof space. Two leaders from the label "Sealed joints" point to where the ceiling meets the wall on each side.
first_draft:
The image contains two sections placed side by side. The left, headed "Diagram 2.35 Wall types 3.1 and 3.2 – ceiling and roof junction", is a vertical section through a cavity wall. A horizontal line at the top is labelled "Roof", and a zigzag element seated in the cavity just below it is labelled "Flexible closer". The wall leaves are drawn with a horizontal broken line to indicate continuation. A lower horizontal line is labelled "Ceiling", and two arrows point to the base of the cavity where it meets this line, labelled "Sealed joints". The word "SECTION" appears at the bottom right.

The right, headed "Diagram 2.36 External cavity wall at eaves level", is a section through an external cavity wall, with a brick outer leaf and a cross-hatched inner leaf. A horizontal element closing the top of the cavity is labelled "Flexible closer". A thin vertical double line runs alongside the inner leaf. The word "SECTION" appears at the bottom right.

A lower horizontal line is labelled "Ceiling", and two arrows point to the zigzag elements in the two cavities at this level, labelled "Sealed joints".
